artifact.name: Z-Girl v3.18 Human-Centered Commercial Foundation RC2

review.evaluator: Greene Media Studio governed production review
review.notes: RC2.3 removes the rejected low-resolution sprite implementation from the Human Support surface. Hero and role cards now render separate 1800px high-quality human photography sources directly in-browser, preserving the approved relationship-centered visual direction while avoiding prior Next Image remote optimizer failures and sprite upscaling artifacts. Public Demo security remains inherited from protected production main.

ai_uses.purpose: Human-centered experience architecture, copy adaptation, visual direction, QA, and governed release preparation
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: AI supports consistent role-specific experience design while trusted human relationships remain central
ai_uses.human_oversight: Owner retains final public-release approval; participant sharing remains controlled; human supporters retain real-world authority
ai_uses.provenance: Application implementation and governed visual direction in lgreene2/zgirl-hero-coach; candidate photography provenance recorded in governance/visual-rights/human-support-unsplash-v1.json

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: Customer entitlements, commission schedules, reseller economics, fundraising activation, visual final acceptance, and public release remain governance decisions rather than automatic actions.

evidence: Role scenes are relationship-specific high-resolution photography rather than sprite crops
Mobile role carousel preserves complete cards with explicit swipe affordance
AI-assisted production and QA enforce the human-first visual and handoff architecture without granting AI professional authority
Visuals emphasize trusted relationships and participant control rather than surveillance or professional substitution
Sprite architecture removed from Human Support surface
Direct browser image rendering avoids the prior remote optimizer failure and destructive sprite enlargement
RC remains based on current protected main
Each role scene retains descriptive alt text from governed scenario content
Mobile horizontal navigation includes a visible swipe cue
Human support remains contextual to the existing Hero Within experience
Public Demo security controls are inherited from current main
No participant reflection data is added to commercial marketing surfaces
Candidate photography source provenance is recorded

exceptions: Candidate photography is governed by its recorded source license and remains subject to final campaign-specific rights/model-release review where applicable.

This RC does not activate public commercial release, paid checkout changes, affiliate commissions, reseller discounts, public fundraising claims, institutional customer entitlements, or new live-data access. Explicit owner approval is required before merge/release.
